# LIGHTNINGASIC

> LIGHTNINGASIC is a Hong Kong-based Bitcoin and cryptocurrency mining hardware company founded in 2013 by JACK LIAO (also founder of Bitcoin Gold / BTG). Over a decade of hardware innovation: Bitcoin/Litecoin dual mining clusters, immersion liquid cooling, hardware wallets, home mining appliances, and AI edge computing devices.

## Company
- [Home](https://lightningasic.com/): Making AI & Blockchain accessible to everyone. About, history, products, contact.
- [About & History](https://lightningasic.com/#about): World's first Bitcoin/Litecoin dual-algorithm mining cluster (2013), BitExchange ATM (2014), liquid cooling, HardID wallet, AI thin clients (2026).

## Products

- [HardID Hardware Wallet](https://lightningasic.com/hardid.html): Fully open-source, air-gapped hardware wallet. Dual EAL6+ secure elements, keys never leave the device. Clear Sign, FIDO2/U2F passkeys, reproducible builds, 25-round security audit, Apache 2.0.
- [BitcoinBall Home Lottery Machines](https://lightningasic.com/bitcoinball.html): Bitcoin miners built into everyday home appliances — digital photo frame (20–50 TH/s, 300–500 W, ≤25 dB), smart alarm clock (10–30 TH/s, 200–350 W, ≤20 dB), smart speaker (30–60 TH/s, 400–800 W, ≤30 dB, available 2027 Q4). SOLO mining, positive-sum home-lottery model.
- [BitExchange Hardware Wallet (2014)](https://lightningasic.com/bitexchange-wallet.html): Early hardware wallet, technical foundation for HardID. Sapphire glass, touch screen, CNC aluminum, PIN + seed phrase.
- [CryoSpring 冷泉 Immersion Liquid Cooling](https://lightningasic.com/cryospring.html): Phase-change immersion liquid cooling for Bitcoin mining ASICs. Lower chip temps, near-silent, dust-free, longer lifespan, overclock support.

## Related
- [Zenity](https://zenity.top): Smart luxury jewelry.
- [IClawMini](https://iclawmini.com): AI edge computing device, 6 TOPS NPU, local 7B model.
